name: DBW pays LP static income on the current pledge over the whole time since the last claim
summary: DBW's staticIncome() paid LP income on the caller's currently pledged LP multiplied by the full time since that address last claimed, so LP pledged just before a claim earned as if held throughout. The attacker cycled flash-loaned LP through 18 contracts, each pledging, claiming and redeeming it, then sold the DBW into the DBW/USDT pair, 17 days after the last upgrade.
notes: Loss is the DBW/USDT pair's USDT; the 503,465 DBW paid from the token contract is valued at what its sale realised (rule 12).
